title.en: night flea market in the gleishalle.

line.en: vintage, secondhand, records and handmade pieces, with streetfood and live music, 17:00 to 22:00 in the hafencity. a 2 euro culture fee at the door.
line.de: vintage, secondhand, schallplatten und handgemachtes, dazu streetfood und live-musik, 17:00 bis 22:00 in der hafencity. 2 euro kulturbeitrag am eingang.
line.tr: vintage, ikinci el, plaklar ve el yapımı parçalar; streetfood ve canlı müzik eşliğinde, hafencity'de 17:00 ile 22:00 arası. girişte 2 euro kültür katkısı.

sparks.why: Nachtflohmarkt in der Gleishalle Oberhafen, Fri 27.11 17:00 to 22:00, EUR 2 fee (hamburg.de, hamburg-tourism.de, hamburg-magazin.de).
